title: CondoGuard Deductible Raise Credit
content:
Rating rule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy for the premium returned when the per-occurrence deductible is raised.

**1. The raise.** A deductible raise moves the per-occurrence deductible on a CondoGuard policy to the next higher of the deductibles the tier offers, and the declarations then show the higher deductible.

**2. Annual premium in force.** The annual premium in force is the current term's premium plus the full-year premium effect of every endorsement effective in the current term that added premium, minus the full-year premium effect of every endorsement effective in the current term that returned premium.

**3. Deductible step credit.** The deductible step credit is the tier's deductible credit factor of the old deductible minus that of the new one: 0.05 for a raise from 500 USD to 1,000 USD, 0.10 for a raise from 1,000 USD to 2,500 USD, and 0.07 for a raise from 2,500 USD to 5,000 USD.

**4. Full-year deductible credit.** The full-year deductible credit is the annual premium in force multiplied by the deductible step credit, rounded half-up to the cent.

**5. Credit for the rest of the term.** The deductible credit for the rest of the term is the full-year deductible credit multiplied by the calendar days from the day the raise takes effect to the expiration date and divided by the calendar days in the term (the calendar days from the term's effective date to its expiration date), rounded half-up to the cent. The full-year figure is rounded first and the day fraction is applied to the rounded figure. Each rounding of the deductible credit to the cent is half-up in exact decimal: a figure lying exactly halfway between two cents goes to the higher cent.

| Deductible before the raise (USD) | Deductible after the raise (USD) | Deductible step credit |
|---|---|---|
| 500 | 1000 | 0.05 |
| 1000 | 2500 | 0.10 |
| 2500 | 5000 | 0.07 |

## Worked rating (hypothetical figures)

Current term's premium 820.00 USD; one endorsement effective in the current term added premium with a full-year effect of 30.00 USD; none returned premium; deductible raised from 1000 USD to 2500 USD; 146 days left in a 365-day term.

1. Annual premium in force: 820.00 plus 30.00, 850.00 USD.
2. Deductible step credit: 0.10.
3. Full-year deductible credit: 850.00 multiplied by 0.10, 85.00 USD.
4. Credit for the rest of the term: 85.00 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365, 34.00 USD.

For the same policy with a deductible of 500 USD raised to 1000 USD, the full-year credit is 850.00 multiplied by 0.05, that is 42.50 USD. Had an endorsement effective in the current term instead returned premium with a full-year effect of 30.00 USD, the annual premium in force would be 790.00 USD.
